observations: Photo 0 shows a small portable keyboard in a pink hard case; keys are visible and there are colored note labels on some keys.
Photo 0 also shows the keyboard lid/case interior and a handle/hinge area; no screen or control panel is clearly readable.
Photo 1 shows the keyboard closed in a pink textured cover/case; a brand/logo text appears to read “AVANT-GARDE MUSIC” (watermark-style).
Photo 2 shows the keyboard from the side/back with the case open/partly visible; the same “AVANT-GARDE MUSIC” text appears (watermark-style).
No clear model number, brand name, or specifications are readable from the photos.

identity.kind: portable mini keyboard (toy/learning-style) in a hard case

claims.claim: Like new, never repaired or opened
claims.evidence: Photos show a keyboard in a case, but there is no seal, inspection sticker, or internal view to confirm it was never opened/repaired.
No photo/video of the keyboard being powered on or keys producing sound.
No receipt/warranty document is shown in the photos.

risks.risk: Whether the keyboard actually powers on and produces sound (some keys may be dead or volume/speaker may fail).
risks.proof: A short video: power on + press a range of keys (left to right) + show volume control (if any) and confirm audio output.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not guaranteed working (worst case: treat as needs testing/possibly faulty).

risks.risk: Missing accessories or incomplete set (power adapter/battery compartment cover, charging cable, stand, etc.).
risks.proof: A photo of everything included laid out (adapter/cable/batteries compartment cover/manual) plus a close-up of the ports/charging area.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as incomplete/unknown accessories (worst case: buyer may need to source power accessories).

risks.risk: Model/brand mismatch: the exact model affects value (some are basic learning keyboards; others have more features).
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the label/sticker on the back/bottom showing brand + model number + power rating.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a generic portable mini/learning keyboard (lowest comparable).

risks.risk: Physical condition issues not obvious in photos (cracked casing, loose hinges, worn keys).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of keybed surface, each corner of the case, and any visible scratches/cracks; plus a hinge/lock close-up.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as used/possibly cosmetically imperfect (worst case: not “like new”).

proof_requests: Video of it powering on and playing (audio audible) with multiple keys pressed.
Clear close-up of the back/bottom label showing brand and model number.
Photos of the included items: receipt/warranty documents and any power adapter/cable/manual (laid out).
Close-up of the case locks/hinges and keybed for any cracks or loose parts.
response.reason: The photos confirm it’s a portable mini keyboard in a case, but they don’t verify the key claim that it works perfectly, nor the exact model/brand for accurate pricing. Request power-on proof and a readable model label.
